Content.SourceString: ……不对！
Content.LocalizedString: …Wait—no!!

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉，停止行动！停止行动！
Content.LocalizedString: Nanally, abort mission! I repeat—abort!!

Content.SourceString: （表情：禁止）
Content.LocalizedString: (emote: no way)

Content.SourceString: 怎么啦怎么啦？我还没找着塔吉多呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Huh? What's wrong? I haven't even found Taygedo yet.

Content.SourceString: （表情：疑惑）
Content.LocalizedString: (emote: puzzled)

Content.SourceString: 计划有变，我们找个家庭餐厅先开展新的作战会议！
Content.LocalizedString: Change of plans! Let's find a family restaurant and hold our new strategy meeting there!

Content.SourceString: 新的作战会议！？
Content.LocalizedString: A new strategy!?

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师也要出席噢！
Content.LocalizedString: The Appraiser has to come too! Mandatory attendance!

Content.SourceString: 收到……
Content.LocalizedString: …Got it.

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅不要胡闹啊，票卖不掉也没关系。
Content.LocalizedString: Haniel, don't get carried away. It's fine if you can't sell the tickets.

Content.SourceString: 放心吧，明音姐！
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry, Akane!

Content.SourceString: 不会胡闹的，而且票也会好好卖掉！
Content.LocalizedString: I've got this. No chaos. Tickets will be sold!

Content.SourceString: （表情：kira☆）
Content.LocalizedString: (emote: shiny☆)

Content.SourceString: （表情：无语）
Content.LocalizedString: (emote: speechless)

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅！演出票派单任务！圆满完成！
Content.LocalizedString: Mission complete! All tickets successfully distributed—courtesy of the one and only Haniel!

Content.SourceString: （表情：得意）
Content.LocalizedString: (emote: proud)

Content.SourceString: 我这边也卖完了。
Content.LocalizedString: Sold out on my end too.

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉呢，不会在噗卡乐园玩起来了吧！
Content.LocalizedString: What about Nanally? Don't tell me she got distracted and started playing at Pukaland!

Content.SourceString: 有这个可能……
Content.LocalizedString: …Wouldn't be surprised.

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅拍了拍娜娜莉 x5
Content.LocalizedString: Haniel pokes Nanally x5

Content.SourceString: 来了来了！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm here, I'm here!

Content.SourceString: 靠谱如本一代目，怎么会贪图一时玩乐，忘记我们的音乐大业呢！已经统统卖掉了！
Content.LocalizedString: You think someone as dependable as the I, the Ichi-daime, would abandon our grand musical mission for fun? Please! Tickets? All gone.

Content.SourceString: （表情：开心）
Content.LocalizedString: (emote: happy)

Content.SourceString: 不过噗卡乐园的新过山车确实很刺激！再去坐一次！
Content.LocalizedString: …But that new roller coaster at Pukaland? Totally worth a second ride.

Content.SourceString: 似乎挺顺利嘛？
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like everything went smoothly.

Content.SourceString: 明天中午就在StarSign集合，演出前最后多排练几次吧。今晚好好休息。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's meet at StarSign around noon tomorrow—get in a few final rehearsals before the show. Rest up tonight.

Content.SourceString: 没问题~
Content.LocalizedString: No problem.

Content.SourceString: 中午见，麻烦明音明天早起开店了。
Content.LocalizedString: See you at noon. Sorry for making you open up early, Akane.

Content.SourceString: 小事小事。
Content.LocalizedString: No worries.

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅呢？不要装没看到哦！今天早点睡觉！
Content.LocalizedString: And Haniel—don't think I didn't see you lurking. No staying up late tonight!

Content.SourceString: （表情：流汗）
Content.LocalizedString: (emote: sweating)

Content.SourceString: 好的~明音姐~
Content.LocalizedString: Got it. Night, Akane.

Content.SourceString: 明天中午见！
Content.LocalizedString: See you all tomorrow at noon!

Content.SourceString: 明天中午，海角广场集合。
Content.LocalizedString: Tomorrow noon! Cape Square!

Content.SourceString: 好的！明音姐，你不生气啦~
Content.LocalizedString: Roger, wilco! Akane! Still mad?

Content.SourceString: 早点睡，别迟到。
Content.LocalizedString: Sleep now, don't be late.

Content.SourceString: 明白了，准时必达！
Content.LocalizedString: Def not!

Content.SourceString: 嗯，收到。
Content.LocalizedString: Got it.

Content.SourceString: 大家看这个看这个！
Content.LocalizedString: Guys, look look look!!
(emote: confused)

Content.SourceString: （视频链接：<Blue>「月亮狗之夜」在即，回首音乐流转</>）
Content.LocalizedString: (video link: <Blue>With Night of Moondog approaching, a look back at music through the years</>)

Content.SourceString: 我看到呗果上有人转的，是「月亮狗之夜」往期冠军组合的剪辑！
Content.LocalizedString: Someone reposted this on Bagel—it's a compilation of past Night of Moondog champions!

Content.SourceString: （表情：大哭）
Content.LocalizedString: (emote: crying)

Content.SourceString: 好几段演出都把我看哭了！明音姐说的上晴塔也看到了！
Content.LocalizedString: So many of those performances made me cry! I even saw the tower Akane mentioned!

Content.SourceString: 太震撼了，「月亮狗之夜」的舞台！我到现在还是难以想象，我们明天就要站上这样的舞台了……
Content.LocalizedString: The Night of Moondog stage is just… breathtaking. I still can't believe we're gonna stand on it tomorrow…

Content.SourceString: T T根本睡不着啊！你们也看看吧！
Content.LocalizedString: T_T I can't sleep at all!! You guys have to watch it too!!

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅。
Content.LocalizedString: Haniel.

Content.SourceString: 首先，你睡不着，不代表我们也要陪你一起睡不着。
Content.LocalizedString: First of all, you not being able to sleep does not mean you need to drag the rest of us into your insomnia spiral.

Content.SourceString: 其次，今天你就是睡不着，也得给我睡！
Content.LocalizedString: Second, even if you can't sleep tonight… you're still going to sleep.

Content.SourceString: 半夜三更要是让我看到你还在呗果上转发转发转发个没完，你就完了！
Content.LocalizedString: If I catch you reposting videos on Bagel at 3 AM again, you're done.

Content.SourceString: （表情：害怕）
Content.LocalizedString: (emote: scared)

Content.SourceString: 毕竟是决战前夜啊！可以理解，可以理解！
Content.LocalizedString: It is the night before the big battle—I get it, I get it!

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅发的视频我就不看了，新鲜的感想要留给明天！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm gonna pass on the video though. Gotta save that emotional gut punch for tomorrow, keep it fresh!

Content.SourceString: 不过，本一代目也有一种怎么都静不下心来的感觉……
Content.LocalizedString: Still… even I, the Ichi-daime, can't calm down.

Content.SourceString: 一闭上眼睛，深受信赖的第二副手——贝斯，就会出现在我眼前！
Content.LocalizedString: Every time I close my eyes, my most trusted partner—my bass—appears before me!

Content.SourceString: 它仿佛在控诉「你怎么能睡得着！」
Content.LocalizedString: It's like it's whispering: "How can you sleep at a time like this!?"

Content.SourceString: （表情：无语）
Content.LocalizedString: (emote: speechless)

Content.SourceString: 放心，明音。我和娜娜莉一起过去，绝对保证她不迟到。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry, Akane. I'll go with Nanally tomorrow. I promise she won't be late.

Content.SourceString: 麻烦你了，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks, Appraiser. Really counting on you.

Content.SourceString: 决定了，明天大家去Q3为鉴定师购置一套贴合校园风格的新服装。
Content.LocalizedString: It's settled—tomorrow we'll all go to Q³ to pick out a new campus-style outfit for the Appraiser.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Where did this all come from?

Content.SourceString: 这……这么突然？而且我穿平时的衣服去不就好了？
Content.LocalizedString: Th-this is all so sudden… Can't I just wear my usual clothes?

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，我看你是完全不懂哦~所谓校园就是代表着青春洋溢的地方啊！不好好打扮一下怎么行？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you really don't get it, huh. School is basically the definition of youthful energy! How could you not get all dressed up for that?

Content.SourceString: 哦吼，鉴定师穿校服的样子吗？想看想看！
Content.LocalizedString: Ooh, the Appraiser in a school uniform? I wanna see, I wanna see!

Content.SourceString: 那就这么决定咯，明天下午两点Q3门口见面。
Content.LocalizedString: Then it's settled—see you at the Q³ entrance tomorrow at 2 PM.

Content.SourceString: 除此之外，我还有个同学想要借这个机会介绍给你们，大家彼此熟悉一下。
Content.LocalizedString: Also, I'd like to take this chance to introduce a classmate of mine to you all, so we can all get to know each other a bit better.

Content.SourceString: 哦？是谁是谁？！明音姐学生时代的同学吗！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh? Who is it, who is it?! Is it one of Akane's classmates from her school days?!

Content.SourceString: 还有神秘人物登场环节？说不定会打听到明音姐学生时代的爆料呐！
Content.LocalizedString: Ooh, a mystery guest? Maybe we'll get some juicy stories from Akane's school days!

Content.SourceString: 别瞎猜了，等到了明天你们不就知道了？今晚先好好休息。
Content.LocalizedString: Quit guessing already—you'll find out tomorrow, okay? Get some rest tonight.

Content.SourceString: 我发现了一个超酷的地方！
Content.LocalizedString: I found this super cool place!

Content.SourceString: 叫什么「谜语人」的占卜小屋！据说占卜超级灵验的！
Content.LocalizedString: It's this little divination hut called the Puzzler's House! They say the divinations are super, super accurate!

Content.SourceString: 我在这里等你们哟！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm here waiting for you!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师，许久没有在一起合练了，别忘了今天要来Star Sign练习啊。
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser! Appraiser! We haven't practiced together in ages! Don't forget we've got rehearsal at StarSign today!

Content.SourceString: 好的，那我现在就过去。
Content.LocalizedString: Okay, I'll head over now.

Content.SourceString: 哼哼~最近手感正好，我已经等不及啦！
Content.LocalizedString: Hehe! I've really been in the groove lately. I can't wait!

Content.SourceString: 是吗，那看来最近有勤奋练习啊。
Content.LocalizedString: Really? Sounds like you've been practicing hard.

Content.SourceString: 那么我们就在Star Sign集合吧，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Then let's meet at StarSign, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 「猫头音！！！！」吉他手哈尼娅，准备出击！
Content.LocalizedString: THE WHOOTS!!!!, Haniel, ready to rock!

Content.SourceString: 「猫头音！！！！」贝斯手娜娜莉，准备出击！
Content.LocalizedString: Nanally, THE WHOOTS!!!!, ready to rock!

Content.SourceString: 「猫头音！！！！」集合！
Content.LocalizedString: THE WHOOTS!!!! Assemble!
